versions.content: In order to support the NM Coordination algorithm in the NmIf module, an indication Nm_SynchronizationPoint provided to the NmIf module only at the repetition cycle boundaries, when the FrNm module is in Network Mode, and when the configuration parameter FRNM_SYNCHRONIZATIONPOINT_ENABLED is set to TRUE.
